mentions.name: Paint Launcher
mentions.description: This app is a minimalist Android home screen launcher that replaces app icons with tappable zones the user paints directly onto their wallpaper. It is currently in beta.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Paint Launcher (beta) – a minimalist Android home screen without icons, where you paint tappable zones onto your wallpaper instead.
